summary: Implemented `v2-cycle-01-query-evidence-preservation`. The canonical clause terminator now requires quantity/procurement markers to start at standalone token boundaries, so embedded `ШТ.`-like fragments inside alphanumeric designations no longer truncate additive canonical retrieval queries. Standalone quantity tails, including numeric-unit and comma-delimited forms, still strip correctly. OpenSpec tasks are marked complete and validation passes.
mechanism_evidence: `test_embedded_quantity_like_designation_fragment_is_preserved` verifies the source query remains unchanged and the canonical alternate retains the full designation plus DN/PN/material evidence: `ХШТ.123 DN 50 PN 16 стальной`.
`test_standalone_quantity_tails_are_still_stripped_at_token_boundaries` verifies genuine standalone tails like `4 шт.` and `, шт. 4` are excluded from the canonical alternate.
The fix is limited to deterministic canonical-query boundary handling; no retrieval, reranking, decision logic, benchmark data, harness policy, or index representation changed.
